capabilities: Scroll to the top or bottom of the current note from the status bar
Scroll to the selection or cursor in edit mode from the ribbon
extras: The README hints at more functionality with '(Not just that)' and mentions additional button options in the plugin settings, but does not document them.
problem: In long notes, reaching the top or bottom requires repeated scrolling or keyboard shortcuts.

relations.evidence: You can use this plugin in a Obsidian browser (should work with the Surfing plugin)
Customize the button style (should work with Style Settings Plugin)

summary: Adds a button that scrolls to the top or bottom of the current note, or to the cursor in edit mode.
